privacy.title: Itangazo ryerekeye ubuzima bwite
privacy.draft: Inyandiko y'agateganyo itegereje kwemezwa n'Ushinzwe Amategeko n'Iyubahirizwa ryayo mu Rugaga.
privacy.body: Dukusanya amakuru bwite akenewe mu kwandika no guha impushya abakomisiyoneri n'ibigo by'ubukomisiyoneri bw'imitungo itimukanwa, no kubungabunga igitabo rusange. Dukusanya buri kintu gusa iyo icyiciro cyawe cyangwa ubwoko bw'ubusabe bwawe bubisaba. Amakuru yawe arinzwe (encrypted), agerwaho n'abakozi bayakeneye mu kazi gusa, kandi buri gihe amakuru y'ibanga arebwe birandikwa. Amakuru agaragara mu mategeko agenga igitabo ni yo yonyine atangazwa. Ushobora gusaba kopi y'amakuru yawe igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
privacy.metaDescription: Uko urubuga rukusanya, rurinda kandi rutangaza amakuru bwite.
